trigger: Actual -File SecurityError with all five policy scopes Undefined; syntax and all9media hashes already passed.
source_rule: analysis/launcher-current-runtime-v1/run-plan.json requires stop on policy denial; CUA policy requires action-time confirmation before weakening protections.
proposal: Use -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned only for each dedicated Windows PowerShell process running this fixed script in modes Verify, Install, Observe, Restore, in that prerequisite order. No persistent/user/machine/GPO change.
impact: This permits unsigned local scripts within the dedicated PowerShell session and inherited child sessions; RemoteSigned is not an exact-script allowlist. We invoke only the hash-verified original project helper. Existing file/hash/path/process guards remain.
existing_effect_scope: Verify is read-only; Install creates new verified4filebackup and replaces only fixed runtime EXE; Observe records one normal RunAs/noargument attempt with parent90s bound after UAC return; Restore restores only replaced EXE and allowed attributes after no matching process.
recovery: Session policy is not stored in registry and ends when the process/child sessions exit. Preserve original4files backups. If any actual policy/security denial, hash/process mismatch, new legal/credential/unexpected permission gate occurs, stop again; no Bypass, Unrestricted, Unblock-File, inline equivalent or other workaround.
